connections.boundary: Dataset and current project grants required. Inventory reads owner-assigned ordinary and AI tasks directly linked to a connected project, with pagination and eligibility reasons. Claim/finish cover AI draft/review tasks only. Unassigned supplier confirmations need separate preparation. Completion saves a note and finishes only the claimed task. Ordinary Agent backlog import requires a separately approved per-project source-site mapping and a current owner connection. Preserves CRM completion, assignment and scheduling; conflicts on edits and version changes. No deletions or authority grants.

Requires an existing owner-bound managed source connection, selected project and current source authority. Preview/status do not approve or publish. Never pass source tokens through tool arguments. Execution additionally requires the existing managed sources:execute grant and current source policy; exceptions remain held.
